payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear explanation of the reasoning behind the selection of threshold values, including the distribution of class labels and the necessity for distituents to outnumber constituents.

claims.text: The threshold values are chosen to ensure a distribution of class labels of about 1:10, with distituents being the majority.
The lower and upper bounds of the thresholds are set to τ min as 0.0005 and τ max as 0.995 to classify outside strings as gold-standard.
The choice of thresholds takes into account the skewness of random spans, ensuring that distituents outnumber constituents.
